dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Haha, this is some fine mead. Sharing the fruits of our labor with friends is way more fun than drinking alone.

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: My only teensy-weensy criticism is that these cups are a bit on the small side. I can't quite drink to my heart's content...

dialogues.speaker: Venti
dialogues.text: Suppose I'll just have to go grab a few more in a minute. Maybe that'll be enough liquid inspiration for a nice little poem...
